name: Pendulum
author: Erin Carter
description: A row of glowing pendulum bobs hangs from an implied rail, each swinging on its own exact period with a faint phosphor smear behind it. Graded lengths follow the classic pendulum-wave series, so the row drifts order-to-chaos-to-order on one long seamless loop while bob colours blend across the row like a slow colour ribbon.

params.label: Cycle speed
params.effect: Scales all pendulum periods together, compressing or stretching the full order-chaos-order cycle from a minutes-long meditation to a brisk weave.

params.label: Spacing
params.effect: Horizontal distance between pendulums in CSS pixels — dense spacing reads as a continuous luminous curve, wide spacing as countable individual instruments.

params.label: Swing width
params.effect: Full lateral travel of each bob in CSS pixels; small values give a tight nervous shimmer, large values sweep broad overlapping arcs across neighbouring columns.
